fields.summary_ko.0: Berkshire Hathaway (BRK.A, BRK.B) Q3 adjusted operating earnings slightly exceeded expectations, with Class A fair value estimate of $765,000 and Class B fair value of $510 scheduled for upward revision.
fields.summary_ko.1: Stable underwriting profits from the insurance business continue to offset underperformance in other business segments in a typical pattern.
